name: application-tab-bar-mobile
title: Tab Bar (Mobile)
description: Fixed bottom mobile tab bar with an icon and label per tab, an active-tab color state, and an optional numeric badge.
useWhen: Building the primary navigation for a mobile web app or PWA with 3-5 top-level sections.
Users need an always-visible way to switch sections and see an unread count on one of them.
The active section should be clear even at small icon sizes, via color and aria-current, not shape alone.
avoidWhen: You need a floating launcher of app icons rather than a fixed app-shell navigation bar — use Dock instead.
The screen has more than ~5 top-level destinations — collapse extras into a "More" tab or move to a drawer instead of cramming the bar.
responsiveBehavior: Tabs are evenly distributed across the bar's full width via equal flex-basis; this component is intended for narrow (mobile) viewports and should be hidden or replaced by top navigation at wider breakpoints.
accessibility: The bar is a <nav> with aria-label, and the active tab carries aria-current="page".
Each tab is a real link with visible text, so the icon alone never carries the tab's identity.
The badge count is rendered as visible text next to the icon, readable by assistive technology, not just a colored dot.

variants.title: Tab Bar (Mobile)
variants.description: A four-tab bar (Home active, Search, Alerts with a badge count of 3, Profile) in a rounded floating bar.
accessibility: The active tab is distinguishable by color and aria-current, not icon shape alone.

variants.title: Tab Bar (Mobile) (Dark)
variants.description: The same four-tab bar adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-tab color and badge contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
